name: Evidence-Bounded Topology Inference
purpose: Predict plausible console-system behavior when exact schematics or hardware are incomplete without fabricating exact component values.
principles: Infer topology graph before sonic coefficients.
Represent unknown numeric values as bounded ranges with provenance and confidence.
Use ensemble simulation and sensitivity analysis rather than one guessed value.
Spend research effort on high-sensitivity unknowns first.
Behavioral references constrain outcomes but never establish circuit truth.
Topology-inferred results are never production promotion evidence by themselves.
